documents.text: SERVICE AGREEMENT BETWEEN ACME CONSULTING PVT. LTD. AND NORTHSTAR RETAIL LTD. Effective Date: 1 April 2026 Clause 1 - Term of Agreement This Agreement shall commence on 1 April 2026 and shall remain in force for a period of twenty-four (24) months, unless terminated earlier in accordance with Clause 7. Upon expiry, the Agreement may be renewed for successive periods of twelve (12) months by mutual written consent of both parties. Clause 2 - Scope of Services Acme Consulting Pvt. Ltd (the "Consultant") shall provide data analytics, dashboard development, and monthly performance reporting services to Northstar Retail Ltd (the "Client") as further described in Schedule A. The Consultant shall deliver one comprehensive report on the fifteenth day of each calendar month. Clause 3 - Fees and Payment The Client shall pay the Consultant a fixed monthly fee of Rs. 4,50,000 (Rupees Four Lakh Fifty Thousand only), payable within fifteen (15) days of receipt of a valid invoice.

Late payments shall accrue interest at a rate of 1.5% per month on the outstanding balance. Clause 4 - Confidentiality Each party agrees to keep confidential all non-public information disclosed by the other party during the term of this Agreement and for a period of three (3) years following its termination. Confidential information shall not include information that is independently developed or lawfully obtained from a third party. Clause 5 - Intellectual Property All deliverables, reports, dashboards, and analytical models created by the Consultant under this Agreement shall be the exclusive property of the Client upon full payment of applicable fees. The Consultant retains ownership of any pre-existing tools, templates, or proprietary methodologies used in the course of delivering the Services.

The Consultant retains ownership of any pre-existing tools, templates, or proprietary methodologies used in the course of delivering the Services. Clause 6 - Limitation of Liability The Consultant's total liability under this Agreement, whether in contract, tort, or otherwise, shall not exceed the total fees paid by the Client in the six (6) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. Neither party shall be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages. Clause 7 - Termination Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by providing sixty (60) days' written notice to the other party. Either party may terminate this Agreement immediately upon written notice if the other party commits a material breach that remains uncured for thirty (30) days after receiving notice of such breach. Clause 8 - Governing Law This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India.

Clause 8 - Governing Law This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India. The courts at Mumbai shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any disputes arising out of or in connection with this Agreement. Clause 9 - Dispute Resolution In the event of any dispute, the parties shall first attempt to resolve the matter through good-faith negotiation for a period of thirty (30) days. If the dispute remains unresolved, either party may refer the matter to arbitration under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, with the seat of arbitration in Mumbai. Clause 10 - Entire Agreement This Agreement, together with Schedule A, constitutes the entire understanding between the parties and supersedes all prior discussions, negotiations, and agreements, whether written or oral, relating to its subject matter.
